derivation: middle voice from G575 (ἀπό) and (to squeeze, knead, smear);

occurrences.text: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
